Chapter 6437: Yielding

Chapter 6437: Yielding

Whale, an essence ancestor, was not weaker than Stoneboiler or Eight-armed Immortal Child. Moreover, his colossal frame was innately intimidating.

“Looks like Desolate Frontier is coming.” An emperor said softly.

The Li had an unbreakable alliance with Desolate Frontier. Thus, the appearance of their primal ancestors together was not surprising.

“What a shame for Trinity.” An emperor sighed.

Whale Ancestor originated from Trinity but eventually joined Desolate Frontier. If he and Ocean-gaze had stuck around, Trinity might occupy the top position right now.

“How delusional, the likes of you taking over the dream world?” Whale stood before Eight-armed Immortal Child.

“That’s the confidence of someone from the number one lineage.” A spectator commented on Whale’s overbearing attitude.

“It might not be me, but I am sincerely warning everyone to save them.” Eight-armed said.

“If you’re here alone, leave.” Whale demanded.

Stoneboiler came closer to form a pincer formation with him.

The shockwaves from the two primal ancestors sent people flying. Keep in mind that in the dream world, distance and time served as separations.

Eight-armed became startled and summoned three thousand worlds.

“Bam!” Half of them shattered and he staggered backward.

“Starting already?” Others watched with great interest.

“Don’t stand in our way.” The two attackers only wanted to chase Eight-armed away, not kill him.

“You two will be the ones yielding.” Another figure descended.

The flow of time in all areas suddenly stopped. One wing appeared after another on the upper half of the dream world.

When they appeared, time in the vicinity finally flowed again. They released particles illuminating whole regions, turning the dream world into a holy kingdom.

“Pop!” Once all wings appeared, time became normal again.

A youth appeared beneath a total of seventy-two wings, flawless in both appearance and demeanor. He looked like an angel lord from above, giving the illusion of being the number one beneath the high heaven while being in charge of delivering judgments.

“Seventy-two wings.” Someone counted.

Only one person had this appearance in Old World - Seventy-two Origin Ancestor.

He was the progenitor of Seventy-two Skyraiser Sect. Legend has it his parents were ancient emperors who allied with Desolate Ancestor during the wars. However, he ended up joining Moshi to destroy Desolate Frontier.

“Desolate Frontier will not have its way today.” He declared while exerting pressure on the opponents.

Everyone became afraid as his wings descended, seemingly pushing the dream world downward.

Stoneboiler roared and raised a single stone into the air. Whale became resplendent; all the stars on his body channeled their power into his tail for a whip.

“Bam!” They went all out but couldn’t stop the descending wings. The impact affected the dream world, stopping numerous dreams.

Screams could be heard since many natives were crushed, the same for cultivators.

“Are they going to break this place?” A desolate god was horrified.

However, primal ancestors couldn’t break it. More dreams and worlds emerged, stacking upon each other.

Meanwhile, Stoneboiler and Whale staggered backward with a serious expression.

“Fame well deserved.” Whale shouted.

“Still a primal ancestor in the extinguish stage. In the past, just one move would have been enough to injure them.” An emperor commented.

Seventy-two Origin Ancestor was once much stronger. He participated in the assault against Xianting, resulting in his death.
